events.name: Apple WWDC 2026
events.content_hook: Siri 2.0 powered by Gemini brings voice-first shopping to 1B+ iPhones. iOS 27 sets the stage for lock-screen commerce, real-time product search via voice, and on-device AI personalization. Glance angle: how ambient AI on device changes the moment-of-intent for brands.
events.notes: Keynote June 8 at 10am PT. Siri-Gemini integration, iOS 27, task automation (e.g. voice-ordered food/delivery).

events.name: Google I/O 2026
events.location: Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA (+ online)
events.content_hook: Google's Universal Cart lets shoppers add items across Search, Gmail, YouTube, and Gemini — the biggest shift to cross-surface shopping intent in years. Gemini 3.5 Flash + AI Overviews in 30%+ more shopping queries by mid-2026 reshapes discovery funnels. Glance angle: what Universal Cart means for retail media and product discovery.
events.notes: Universal Cart, Shopping Graph enhancements, AI Overviews in shopping queries. On-demand sessions available May 21 onward.

events.name: RetailX / IRCE Chicago
events.content_hook: The anchor US ecommerce trade show of summer 2026. Tracks cover retail media, CRO, omni-channel fulfillment, and AI applications. Glance angle: post-show roundup of biggest tech bets retailers are making — and what they reveal about where commerce attention goes next.
events.notes: Overlaps with NRF Protect (June 8–10) and Apple WWDC (June 8–12) — big week for retail tech.

events.name: Salesforce Connections 2026
events.content_hook: Salesforce's marquee marketing + commerce event. Expect Agentforce-for-retail announcements, AI-driven CRM and loyalty tooling, and Data Cloud updates for personalization at scale. Glance angle: how AI agents in the CRM stack are rewriting retention and loyalty playbooks.
events.notes: Date confirmed June 3–4. Also streaming on Salesforce+.

events.name: CRMC 2026 (CRM & Loyalty Summit)
events.location: Omni PGA Frisco Resort, Frisco, TX
events.content_hook: ~800 senior retail marketers, CRM leads, and loyalty execs convene on data-driven loyalty, AI personalization, and omnichannel lifecycle marketing. Glance angle: what leading retail brands are betting on for loyalty in an AI-first era.
events.notes: Highly curated; brand-focused keynotes and breakout sessions on AI and customer lifecycle.

events.name: NRF Protect 2026
events.content_hook: Loss prevention meets AI: NRF Protect covers retail security, cyber risk, and emerging tech threats. Glance angle: the hidden AI investment retailers are making in fraud and theft prevention — and how it intersects with personalization infrastructure.
events.notes: Focused on retail loss prevention and cyber risk. Smaller audience but signals enterprise retail AI priorities.

events.name: CommerceNext Growth Show 2026
events.location: New York Hilton Midtown, New York City, NY
events.content_hook: Retail and DTC brand marketers focused on customer acquisition, paid media, CRM, retail media networks, and emerging channels. End-of-window capstone event. Glance angle: what retail marketers are betting on for H2 2026 — perfect for a mid-year trend synthesis piece.
events.notes: Speaker lineup announced April 29. Tracks: paid media, data, creative, retail media networks.

events.name: Shopify Editions / Platform Updates (Ongoing June 2026)
events.content_hook: Shopify Functions replacing Scripts, Sidekick AI broadly available, Checkout Extensibility v2, and TikTok Shop native integration all live or launching in this window. No single Unite conference — announcements are now rolling. Glance angle: Shopify's infrastructure push is quietly enabling the next generation of AI-native storefronts.
events.notes: Shopify discontinued the traditional Unite conference format; now uses rolling Editions and blog announcements.

events.name: Google Cloud / AI Follow-Up Content Window
events.content_hook: Google I/O on-demand sessions, Shopping Graph deep-dives, and Gemini API rollouts for merchants go live. Weeks 1–4 post-I/O are highest search intent for 'Google AI shopping', 'Universal Cart', and 'AI Overviews ecommerce'. Glance angle: explainer content on what Universal Cart and Gemini in Search mean for brand discovery strategy.
events.notes: Not a discrete event but a high-intent content window immediately following Google I/O May 19–21.

events.name: Nashville eCom Summit 2026
events.content_hook: Emerging DTC and independent ecommerce operators summit. Glance angle: grassroots signal on what mid-market brands are adopting — a useful counter-signal to enterprise-heavy events in the same week.
events.notes: Smaller regional event; useful for community-level signal.
